Built around you

Your vision.
From the very start.

At MK Leisure, we design and build fully custom leisure boats, houseboats and floating platforms to match your lifestyle, purpose and adventures.

Whether you’re imagining a luxury houseboat, a weekend getaway vessel or a place to bring people together, your ideas shape the brief. The layout, finishes and the way you use the space all begin with you.

From concept to completion, we handle the design, engineering and build — bringing your vision to the water.
